title: Two YAML libraries (yaml and js-yaml), and the !!js dialect defined in three files that must agree
Glob patterns depend on picomatch quirks (a regular-expression pattern) and on four different per-call option sets
A valid version means loose spelling at some call sites and canonical spelling at others
App command lines are coupled to commander: a private field is read and its errors are recognised by shape

reason: The library that parses cordis.yml, carries the !!js tag and edits files while keeping comments is replaced by go.yaml.in/yaml/v4 behind one harness package that fixes the dialect, keeps every comment on write-back and verifies each rendered file before it replaces the original.

The second YAML parser, left in release tooling, test support and build scripts after the loader moved to yaml, has no Go counterpart: hand-written YAML is read by the one harness YAML package and machine-written files such as the update feed become JSON read by encoding/json.

It is used only for parseShell, the grammar of the JavaScript shell that the experimental browser Preview needs because a Web Worker has no processes; a Go host runs a real shell, so no shell grammar is carried, and mvdan.cc/sh/v3 is recorded as the module to use if the owner keeps the Preview under OD-11.

Glob matching for watcher ignore lists, review-layer lists and sidebar address routing is done by github.com/bmatcuk/doublestar/v4 behind one helper with a single documented dialect; the call sites that exist only for the browser Preview image and npm packaging do not carry over.

Interpreting the exports and imports maps of an npm package exists only because plugins are loaded as Node modules; a plugin process is started from a manifest that names its executable and assets by relative path, opened through os.Root so that no path can leave the plugin directory.

npm repository shorthands and the list of hosts pnpm treats specially disappear with npm packages; the remaining need, deriving host, project, clone address and web page from one full repository address, is a few string rules over net/url.

Version validation, ordering, prerelease detection and range checks for plugin compatibility, plugin updates, the model-listing gate and the desktop update use github.com/Masterminds/semver/v3 behind one helper that accepts only strict spelling and always counts prereleases in ranges; the npm peer-range arithmetic and Node and pnpm version checks are not carried over.

The two-stage command line (launcher options, then the options of the app a profile mounts) is parsed by github.com/spf13/pflag, with github.com/spf13/cobra for the fixed command tree, help and completion; apps declare options through a harness type and receive errors as values, so no library type is part of a component's contract.

The Go harness imports one YAML module from one package, which defines the dialect and the !expr tag once; a test over the import graph fails if a second YAML module or a second importing package appears.

All globs go through one helper with one written dialect that has no regular-expression pass-through and matches dot names everywhere; case folding and base-name matching are the only options and are named at the call site.
One helper parses versions with the module's strict parser only and passes a version type instead of strings, so a version cannot be accepted by one check and rejected by the next.

Apps describe their options with a harness Spec type and get values, a help request or a usage error back; the parsing library is hidden inside one package and one binary links one copy of it, so no private field or error shape is inspected.

title: One YAML module, one dialect, defined once
Comments are preserved; layout is canonical
The harness, not the module, fixes the YAML dialect
No shell language implementation in the harness
No shell interpreter package is linked into the ordinary binary
One glob dialect, one helper, options by name
One strict version type and one range dialect
Apps declare options through a harness type, not a library type
Launcher options come before the profile name
Exactly one package imports the YAML module
Invalid and non-dialect YAML is rejected with line and column
Unquoted scalars are typed by the YAML 1.2 core rules, equal to the JSON form
Each edit operation keeps every comment and every untouched value
The written layout is stable and keeps blank lines between entries
A rendered file that lost a comment or changed data is refused
Limits, panic recovery and deterministic dump
No second YAML module is imported; machine-written files decode strictly as JSON
The glob dialect matches the upstream pattern lists as specified
Fold-case, base-name and include-exclude sets
Malformed and over-long patterns are errors; matching is bounded
Only strict version spelling is accepted and it is kept exactly
Ordering, prerelease detection and the at-least gate
Ranges, with prereleases counted
The launcher hands app words on unchanged
App options declared at run time parse in every supported form, with declared rules
Parsing neither prints nor exits; help and usage errors are values
The generated command reference is fresh
Repository addresses parse to host, project, clone and page addresses, or are rejected with a reason
Manifest paths resolve inside the plugin directory or are refused
